title: Raanjhanaa
desc: A carefree youngster sacrifices his love after his childhood sweetheart plans to marry a man from her own community. Nevertheless, fate convinces him to pursue his lady love at any cost.

title: Rudrangi
desc: Bheem Rao Deshmukh, a tyrant who oppresses his people, is drawn to a beautiful woman named Rudrangi and desires physical contact with her. In order to satisfy his obsession, he terrorises her village.

title: Andaaz
desc: After his sweetheart Kajal marries another man, Raj moves to Cape Town. He eventually agrees to marry Jiya but is shocked to find that she is Kajal's widowed sister-in-law.

title: Toofan
desc: Separated at birth, the paths of Shyam, a lousy magician unwittingly roped into a crime, and Toofan, a defender of the people, cross again years later as they reunite to avenge their father.

title: Sky Force
desc: Brave heroes embark on a quest for truth as India and Pakistan enter an airstrike war that threatens to pose deadly consequences.
